description: Ensemble testing for front-end web quality
author: Jonathan Robert Pool

tool_signatures.name: awaitTest
tool_signatures.description: Waits for a job ordered via the orderNewTest or orderRetest tool to finish, using the report identifier either tool returned. Use this instead of polling listIssues when an immediate answer is preferred. Blocks until the report is ready, the job fails, or a maximum wait time elapses, sending no interim notices; returns the finished job’s status and, if ready, its report identifier.

tool_signatures.name: cherry
tool_signatures.description: Example Page

tool_signatures.name: getKilotestOverview
tool_signatures.description: Explains what Kilotest is, what its tools do, and how its results are structured. Use this before any other tool when the available tools or workflow are unclear. Returns a prose overview of the Kilotest domain, the tool workflow, and links to further documentation. ${sharedContext}

tool_signatures.name: getReport
tool_signatures.description: Retrieves one entire report as JSON, with all of its issues, violators, and diagnoses. Use this instead of drilling down through listIssues, listViolators, and listDiagnoses when the full report is needed in one call. Returns the complete report data for the specified timestamp and job identifier. The size of the report is disclosed by the listIssues tool.

tool_signatures.name: listDiagnoses
tool_signatures.description: Lists the diagnoses that rule engines gave for how one element exhibited one issue in one report. Use this after listViolators to get details about the element as a violator of the issue. Returns, for each rule engine that reported a violation by the element of a rule belonging to the issue, the diagnosis given by the rule engine.

tool_signatures.name: listIssues
tool_signatures.description: Lists the issues reported in one report, along with the history of all reports about the same page. Use this after listPages to switch to an earlier or later report or to begin examining this report. Returns the history and the basics about this report’s issues.

tool_signatures.name: listPages
tool_signatures.description: Lists all pages Kilotest has tested. Use this first to discover whether a page already has any reports before requesting a test. Returns, for each tested page, its description, URL, and the timestamp and job identifier of its latest available report.

tool_signatures.name: listViolators
tool_signatures.description: Lists the elements of a tested page that were reported as exhibiting one issue in one report. Use this after listIssues to drill down from an issue to the elements violating rules belonging to that issue. Returns basics about each violating element.

tool_signatures.name: orderNewTest
tool_signatures.description: Orders testing of a page that has no report yet, with automated approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved. Use this instead of requestNewTest when immediate testing is wanted; testing typically takes 2 to 4 minutes. Returns an order confirmation and disposition details, including, if approved, a report identifier (timestamp and job identifier) and a question about whether to wait for completion with the awaitTest tool.

tool_signatures.name: orderRetest
tool_signatures.description: Orders a retest of a page whose existing report is considered obsolete, with automated approval or rejection and immediate enqueuing if approved. Use this instead of requestRetest when immediate retesting is wanted; testing typically takes 2 to 4 minutes. Returns an order confirmation and disposition details, including, if approved, a report identifier (timestamp and job identifier) and a question about whether to wait for completion with the awaitTest tool.

tool_signatures.name: requestFeature
tool_signatures.description: Submits a request to add a new feature or improve an existing one; queued for manager review. There is no immediate-approval alternative for feature requests. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.

tool_signatures.name: requestNewTest
tool_signatures.description: Submits a request to test a page that has no report yet; queued for manager approval. Use orderNewTest instead for immediate, automatically approved testing. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.

tool_signatures.name: requestRetest
tool_signatures.description: Submits a request to retest a page whose existing report is considered obsolete; queued for manager approval. Use orderRetest instead for immediate, automatically approved retesting. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.
